top_signals.title: Nihon Hidankyo renews call for world without nuclear weapons
top_signals.summary: The Japan Confederation of A- and H-Bomb Sufferers Organizations, held a news conference in Nagasaki on the 70th anniversary of the group's establishment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
